newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama students, police clash, five hurt.
newsitem.headline: Panama students, police clash, five hurt.

text.p: Stone-throwing students at the University of Panama clashed with riot police on Wednesday during a demonstration to demand the return of leftist student leaders suspended earlier this year on vandalism charges.
The demonstration involved 300 students at the country's largest university and left at least five people injured. There were no immediate reports of any arrests.

Red Cross officials said they treated two students for minor shoulder and head wounds sustained when police shot rubber bullets at the demonstrators. Protesters inflicted minor lacerations on three police officers, police said.

The students, many covering their faces with cloth to disguise their identity, blocked traffic along Simon Bolivar Avenue, one of Panama City's main thoroughfares that runs in front of the university.
